# CalculatePilot

> CalculatePilot is a free website of 167 online calculators for finance, health, math, and everyday use. No account. Every result includes the formula and a short methodology. Calculations run in the browser and are not stored on our servers.

Site: https://www.calculatepilot.com
Sitemap: https://www.calculatepilot.com/sitemap.xml
Embed any calculator: https://www.calculatepilot.com/embed/
Methodology: https://www.calculatepilot.com/methodology.html
Guides: https://www.calculatepilot.com/guides/
Search: https://www.calculatepilot.com/search.html

How to cite: name the specific calculator page URL. Results are estimates, not professional financial, medical, or legal advice.
Preferred crawlers: OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, CCBot. Do not treat /embed/ pages as canonical — use the matching calculator URL instead.

## Start here (highest-intent pages)

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/mortgage-calculator.html): monthly principal and interest plus tax and insurance; standard amortization formula (US-style PITI).
- [UK Mortgage Repayment Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-mortgage-repayment-calculator.html): 25-year UK repayment vs interest-only in pounds. Stamp Duty is a purchase cost, not a monthly line. Not a currency overlay of the PITI page.
- [UK Mortgage Overpayment Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-mortgage-overpayment-calculator.html): months and interest saved by a regular extra payment on an existing UK repayment mortgage. Distinct job from repayment vs interest-only.
- [UK Stamp Duty Comparison](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-stamp-duty-comparison.html): one price under SDLT, LBTT and LTT. Main home, first-time buyer, additional property, and non-residential freehold (£275,000 shop = £3,250 / £2,250 / £1,500). Not a fourth statute and not a city page.
- [UK Stamp Duty Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-stamp-duty-calculator.html): SDLT for England and Northern Ireland. Residential bands from 1 April 2025, plus non-residential or mixed-use freehold at 0/2/5% (GOV.UK £275,000 = £3,250). Lease rent is not calculated. Not Scotland LBTT or Wales LTT.
- [Scotland LBTT Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/scotland-lbtt-calculator.html): Land and Buildings Transaction Tax for Scotland. Residential nil-rate £145,000, first-time buyer relief to £175,000, 8% ADS, plus non-residential freehold at 0/1/5% (£465,000 = £11,750; £872,000 office = £32,100). Lease rent is not calculated. Not a token-swap of English SDLT.
- [Wales LTT Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/wales-ltt-calculator.html): Land Transaction Tax for Wales. £225,000 nil-rate band, no first-time buyer relief, separate higher-rate table from 11 December 2024, plus non-residential freehold from 22 December 2020 (£300,000 premises = £2,750). Lease rent is not calculated. Not a token-swap of English SDLT.
- [UK Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-student-loan-repayment-calculator.html): PAYE deduction from UK salary using 2026/27 Plan 1/2/4/5 and postgraduate thresholds. Income-contingent, not a currency overlay of the US amortising student-loan page.
- [UK Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/uk-take-home-pay-calculator.html): England, Wales and NI net pay after 2026/27 income tax, Class 1 employee NI and optional student-loan PAYE. Not a currency overlay of the US paycheck page.
- [Scotland Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/scotland-take-home-pay-calculator.html): Scottish income tax 2026/27 (19% to 48%) plus UK Class 1 NI. Starter ceiling £16,537 (was £15,397 in 2025/26); basic ceiling £29,526 (was £27,491). Rates unchanged. £11.40 less tax at £20,000 than last year’s Scottish bands; £31.75 less from £29,527 to £100,000. Also shows the gap versus England, Wales and NI. Not a token-swap of the rUK page.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/loan-calculator.html): monthly payment, total interest, and total repayment for a fixed-rate loan.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/compound-interest-calculator.html): future value with an initial deposit and recurring contributions.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/math/percentage-calculator.html): percent of a number, what percent X is of Y, and percent change.
- [Discount Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/discount-calculator.html): sale price and amount saved; explains stacked discounts.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial/sales-tax-calculator.html): tax amount and final price from a rate.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/health/bmi-calculator.html): body mass index from height and weight, with category.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/health/calorie-calculator.html): daily calorie needs via Mifflin-St Jeor BMR and activity factor.
- [Macro Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/health/macro-calculator.html): protein, fat, and carb gram targets from calories and a split.
- [Age Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other/age-calculator.html): exact age in years, months, and days, plus days lived.
- [GPA Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other/gpa-calculator.html): weighted GPA on a 4.0 scale with credit hours.
- [Tip Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other/tip-calculator.html): tip, total, and per-person split.
- [Date Calculator](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other/date-calculator.html): days, weeks, and months between two dates.

## Category indexes

- [All calculators](https://www.calculatepilot.com/): 167 tools, search and categories.
- [Search](https://www.calculatepilot.com/search.html): crawlable filtered list from the calculator inventory.
- [Financial](https://www.calculatepilot.com/financial-calculators.html): 52 tools — mortgages (US PITI, UK repayment, UK overpayment), England & NI SDLT, Scotland LBTT, Wales LTT, UK student-loan PAYE, rUK and Scottish take-home pay, loans, tax, retirement, investing. Multi-currency.
- [Health & Fitness](https://www.calculatepilot.com/health-calculators.html): 30+ tools — BMI, calories, macros, pregnancy, body composition.
- [Math](https://www.calculatepilot.com/math-calculators.html): 40+ tools — algebra, geometry, statistics, percentages.
- [Everyday](https://www.calculatepilot.com/other-calculators.html): 45+ tools — age, time, GPA, tips, conversions, home and auto.
